mapper.sql: SELECT f.create_time AS followed_at, f.last_notified_chapter_id, f.last_notified_at, CASE WHEN b.last_chapter_id IS NOT NULL AND (f.last_notified_chapter_id IS NULL OR f.last_notified_chapter_id <> b.last_chapter_id) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS has_update, b.id AS book_id, b.book_name AS book_name, b.author_name AS author_name, b.category_id AS category_id, c.category_name AS category_name, b.pic_url AS pic_url, b.book_desc AS book_desc, b.book_status AS book_status, b.word_count AS word_count, b.visit_count AS visit_count, b.chapter_count AS chapter_count, b.first_chapter_id AS first_chapter_id, b.last_chapter_id AS last_chapter_id, b.last_chapter_name AS last_chapter_name, b.last_chapter_update_time AS last_chapter_update_time, b.status AS book_status_flag, b.create_time AS book_create_time, b.update_time AS book_update_time FROM user_book_follow f JOIN book_info b ON b.id = f.book_id AND b.status = 0 JOIN book_category c ON c.id = b.category_id AND c.status = 0
mapper.select: WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY has_update DESC, b.last_chapter_update_time DESC, f.create_time DESC, f.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_book_follow ( user_id, book_id, last_notified_chapter_id, last_notified_at, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{bookId}, #{chapterId}, NOW(), NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE update_time = NOW()
